messages:
sam-sales: FYI urgent ask from Hygea Health (large payer). CISO requests BYO-KMS + a dedicated peering path and wants a firm throughput guarantee for the pilot. They also asked for a pilot discount if we commit reserved capacity. Need a short one-pager of blockers + rough timelines before the 11:30 PT leadership sync.
lee-se: Clarify whether throughput guarantee = SLA (p99 latency + min rps) or just provisioning a reserved pool. That changes pricing.
nina-eng: Technical note: BYO-KMS integration is standard (our client-side wrap), but for peering we'll need a BGP peering runbook + IP allowlist + MTU checks. Estimate: docs + infra config ~72 hours if infra prioritizes it. Failover plan for degraded peering needs an alternate region or fallback to hosted endpoints.
ara-legal: If Hygea insists on BYO-KMS we need to know key custody model. If they hold keys entirely, legal likely needs a KMS addendum and to confirm log exportability. Please escalate if they want key access proofs (attestation) vs just encrypted blobs.
jules-cs: I'll draft the POC options slide. Two recommended paths:
- Option 1 (fast): Our KMS + peering. Timeline: ~48 hours for peering test, no legal addendum. Cost: baseline POC + small peering setup fee.
- Option 2 (BYO): Customer KMS + peering. Timeline: ~3-5 business days (legal + ops). Add ~10-15% ops uplift for attestation and support.
sam-sales: Finance asks for a quick delta: reserved capacity vs on-demand for a 4-week pilot at 50 rps sustained. Can someone give a back-of-envelope? We need numbers in the one-pager.
lee-se: Ballpark: reserved (monthly commit) ~35-45% cheaper for steady load. For a 4-week pilot we can offer a trial reserved rate at -20% off list to close, but need revenue approval. I'll include sample calc in the doc.
nina-eng: Ops needs these deliverables for the exec bridge: network diagram (peering + CIDRs), KMS handoff flow, and a simple runbook with verification commands. I'll attach a small verification snippet we can hand them:
```
# BGP health check & peering test
show bgp neighbors | include hygea
traceroute 10.11.12.1
iperf3 -c 10.11.12.1 -t 10
```
ara-legal: Also flagging data residency + logs retention items from their questionnaire. I'll annotate the questionnaire and mark anything needing legal signoff.
jules-cs: I'll run a micro-run (sample traffic) on hosted + reserved to capture latency and token-cost delta and add one slide with expected cost variance.
scheduler-bot: Meeting created: Exec bridge with Hygea CISO scheduled 2026-05-14 11:30 PT. Invitees: sam-sales, lee-se, nina-eng, ara-legal, jules-cs, hygea-ciso. Link: https://meet.company/bridge/1719992222
sam-sales: Ownerwise: Lee = pricing + reserved calc (due 10:30 PT), Nina = infra diagrams & runbook (due 10:30 PT), Ara = legal annotations (due 10:00 PT), Jules = POC slide + cost delta (due 10:45 PT). I'll assemble the one-pager at 10:50 and post to exec channel. Ping me if blocked. :pray:
